title: GOD WILL SURPRISE YOU BEFORE THIS WEEK ENDS - PRAY THIS NOW
text: There is a sound in this house tonight that heaven has been waiting to release, and I want you to lift your hands right where you are because before I open my mouth to preach one word, the spirit of the living God is already moving over the gathering searching for a heart that is tired of waiting and ready to receive. Something shifted the moment you walked in here. You did not come here by accident. Every step that brought you to this place tonight was ordered, was arranged, was orchestrated by a father who saw this exact moment on the calendar of your life before the foundation of the world. So, I speak to your spirit before I speak to your mind. Relax. Breathe. The atmosphere is about to change. I want you to say this out loud wherever you are, whatever you are carrying. Before this week ends, God will surprise me. Say it again like you mean it. Say it like your bills are already changing. Say it like your body's already responding. Say it like your marriage is already mending. Say it like your children are already coming home. Say it like the door you have been knocking on is already swinging open on hinges that heaven has been oiling in the secret place while you slept because that is exactly what tonight is about. [music] Not motivation, not hype, not a nice phrase to make you feel good until Monday morning reality slaps you back into discouragement. No. Tonight is a prophetic announcement, and I carry it with the full weight of apostolic authority. God is not finished with this week. Whatever this week has looked like so far, however dry, however silent, however delayed, I declare to you that the ending of it does not have to match the beginning of it. Genesis 1:2 tells us that the earth was without form and void, and darkness was upon the face of the deep. That is how some of your week started. Empty, formless, void, dark. But verse 3 did not stay silent. And God said, there is a but God said coming for your situation before the sun sets on this week. Somebody said, "Prophet, my week is almost gone. There's barely any time left." Beloved, time is not a limitation to the ancient of days. He does not need seven days to do what he can do in seven seconds. Ecclesiastes 3:1 tells us there is a time for every purpose under heaven. And I decree over you tonight that this is your time. Not next month, not next quarter, not when things settle down, now, this week, before the calendar turns. Let the fire fall in this place. I sense a company of people here whose faith has been stretched so thin that you have started negotiating with disappointment. You've started rehearsing the excuses in advance. Maybe it wasn't meant to be. Maybe I'm asking too much. Maybe this is just my portion in life. I rebuke that spirit of premature surrender in the name of Jesus. You are not asking too much from a God who spoke galaxies into existence with a sentence. You are not too complicated for the one who formed the intricacies of your inward parts in your mother's womb. Psalm 139:13 says, "For thou hast possessed my reins. Thou hast covered me in my mother's womb." The same precision that knit you together is still available to reorganize your circumstances. He has not run out of ability. He has not grown tired. He is not distracted by someone else's testimony while yours sits on a shelf collecting dust. Your file is open. Your name is being called. And I declare before this week ends, somebody's file that has been marked pending is about to be stamped approved. Let's go deeper because I don't want to leave you with a feeling. I want to leave you with revelation because revelation outlasts emotion. When the Bible describes surprise, it doesn't describe it the way we casually use the word in scripture. Divine surprise is a sudden reversal engineered in the unseen realm before it manifests visibly. Look at Job. Job chapter 42:10 says, "The Lord turned the captivity of Job when he prayed for his friends and gave Job twice as much as he had before. Twice. Not a small consolation, not a token gesture, double. And I want you to notice the timing. It wasn't when Job demanded it, it wasn't on Job's schedule. It happened after a long season of silence, confusion, accusation, and pain. And it happened suddenly in one movement of divine intervention. That's the pattern. Long silence, sudden turnaround. And if that is the pattern in scripture, it is the pattern available to you. I feel led to remind somebody here the delay was never a denial. Habakkuk 2:3 says, "For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak and not lie. Though it tarry, wait for it because it will surely come. It will not tarry." Underline that phrase. It will not tarry. It has an expiration date on its delay. There is a limit to how long your waiting season can legally hold you. And I sense that limit is expiring this week. Church, can I be honest with you? Some of you have prayed so long for the same thing that you've stopped expecting an answer and started merely reciting a request. There's a difference between praying in faith and praying out of habit. Habitual prayer says the words but has quietly buried the hope. Faith-filled prayer says the words and watches the door. Tonight, I am calling the hope out of the grave you buried it in. Ezekiel 37:4, "Prophesy upon these bones and say unto them, 'O ye dry bones, hear the word of the Lord.'" I speak to the dry bones of your expectation, live. I speak to the dry bones of your dream, live. I speak to the dry bones of that report you received, that rejection letter, that silence from the man you love, that stagnant business account, live in the name of Jesus. I decree over every person reading or hearing this word, your week is not over, your case is not closed. Your prayer did not hit the ceiling and fall back down. It went through, it registered, it is being processed by a judge who does not lose paperwork. Isaiah 65:24 says, "And it shall come to pass that before they call, I will answer, and while they are yet speaking, I will hear." That means some of you are about to receive answers to prayers you haven't even finished praying. The answer is running ahead of the request. Somebody shout "Ahead of schedule" because that's what I see over your life. God is not running late, you have simply been watching the wrong clock. Let me minister to the parents in the room whose children have wandered. I see some of you carrying names in your spirit, sons, daughters, nephews, spiritual children who drifted from the altar, who stopped answering calls, who chose paths that break your heart at 2:00 a.m. when the house is quiet and everyone else is asleep. I decree by the authority given to the church, before this week ends, there is a phone call coming. There is a message coming, there is a door opening in the heart of a prodigal that no counselor could open, no argument could open, no ultimatum could open, but the Holy Spirit is opening it now. >> [music] >> Luke 15:20 says, "And when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him and had compassion and ran and fell on his neck and kissed him. That father did not wait at the gate ringing his hands in despair. He was watching. He was positioned. He was ready to run the moment he saw movement on the horizon. I speak to every parent here. Get up from the posture of despair and take the posture of watching because a way off does not mean never a great way off means the return has already started. It just hasn't reached your doorstep yet. I want to shift the atmosphere here and prophesy something specific over the finances in this house. I sense restriction. I sense accounts that have been operating on fumes. I sense business owners who have been smiling in public and calculating losses in private. I sense salary earners whose income cannot keep pace with the pressure of their obligations. Listen to me. Malachi 3:10 is not a suggestion. It is a covenant clause. Prove me now here with sayeth the Lord of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven and pour you out a blessing that there shall not be room enough to receive it. Windows, not a window, plural provision for a singular need. I decree over every closed financial gate in this house, be opened. I don't care what the bank statement said last week. I don't care what the invoice said. I don't care what the salary structure look like. There is a supernatural override coming. Deuteronomy 8:18 says, but thou shall remember the Lord thy God for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth. That power is being released tonight. And I declare that before this week ends, somebody will receive money from a source they did not plan, did not budget, and cannot fully explain, and it would be enough to move you from panic to peace. Somebody just felt something shift in your chest. That's not coincidence. That's confirmation. Hold on to that. Let me speak now with fire because I feel the weight of warfare pressing on this world. Not everything standing between you and your breakthrough is natural. Some of it is assigned. Ephesians 6:12 says, "For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places." I speak to every principality that has camped itself over the affairs of the people in this place, every satanic gatekeeper stationed at the door of your breakthrough, collecting toll, delaying paperwork, scattering confusion, frustrating agreements, I command you in the name that is above every name, release your hold this week, not next season, this week. I feel led to pray now, and I want you to pray with me, not casually, not politely, but like your life depends on it because in some cases it genuinely does. Father, in the mighty name of Jesus, we come before you tonight as a people desperate for divine intervention. We're not asking for entertainment, we're asking for encounter. Let the fire that fell in the book of Acts chapter 2 fall in this place right now. Let every dead situation represented in this gathering receive the shaking that Ezekiel's valley received. Lord, you said in Jeremiah 1:12 that you watch over your word to perform it. We hold you to your word tonight. Perform it, Father. Perform it in the finances. Perform it in the marriages. Perform it in the bodies that are sick. Perform it in the wombs that are closed. Perform it in the businesses that are struggling. Perform it in the relationships that are broken. We are not asking you to walk a miracle that contradicts your nature. We are asking you to be exactly who you have always been. The God who shows up suddenly, decisively, unmistakably. I decree destiny restoration over every life connected to this world. Joel 2 verse 25 says, "And I will restore to you the years that the locust have eaten, the cankerworm and the caterpillar and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you. Whatever has been eaten, years of delay, years of misdirection, years lost to wrong relationships, wrong jobs, wrong cities, wrong decisions made in desperation instead of discernment. I declare that restoration is not a future hope. It is a present operation. God is not simply giving you new years. He's giving you back the ones that were stolen, compressed into a shorter timeline, so that what should have taken a decade will show up in a season. I speak now to every family under assault. There is a spirit that specializes in fracturing households, turning siblings against each other, poisoning the relationship between parents and children, planting suspicion between husband and wife, opening the door for extended family interference dressed up as concern. I bind that spirit of division in the name of Jesus. Psalm 133 verse 1 declares, "Behold how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity." I decree that unity is returning to the households represented here. The silence at your dinner table is about to break. The cold war in your extended family is about to end. The child who stopped calling home is about to remember the number. To every married couple carrying private pain, I see you. I sense marriages that look intact on the outside but are hollow on the inside. I sense couples who haven't had a real conversation in months, only logistics. I sense bedrooms that have become battlegrounds instead of sanctuaries. I decree breakthrough over your marriage tonight. Ecclesiastes 4:12 says, "And if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him. >> [music] >> And a threefold cord is not quickly broken." I call the third strand back into your union, the presence of God that first joined you together. I declare that the affection that has grown cold is being rekindled. I declare that the misunderstandings that built walls are being demolished. I declare that this week someone's spouse will initiate a conversation that has been overdue for a long time, and it will open a door that counseling alone could not open. And to the singles believing for marriage, I have not forgotten you. Genesis 2:18 says, "And the Lord God said, it is not good that the man should be alone. I will make him an helpmeet for him." God is still in the business of divine connections. I decree that the isolation you've been experiencing is not a life sentence, it is a season, and the season is closing. Someone's aligned helper is being repositioned this week, not to replace you, but to complete an assignment God has already written for both of you. Let's talk about health because I sense there are bodies in this gathering fighting battles that words alone cannot fix, but words carry authority when they carry the name of Jesus. Exodus 15:26 says, "I am the Lord that healeth thee." Not I was, I am, present tense, ongoing identity. I lay hands in the spirit on every diagnosis represented here tonight. I speak to every tumor, every infection, every unexplained pain, every test result awaiting confirmation, you will not have the final say over this life. Psalm 118:17 declares, "I shall not die, but live and declare the works of the Lord." I decree recovery. I decree strength returning to weakened bodies. I decree that the next test will read differently than the last one. I decree that this week somebody receives a medical report that defies the trajectory the doctors expected and even the doctors will have no explanation except to call it what it is, a miracle. Now, I want to pray specifically against every evil altar and covenant working against destinies in this place. Some of what you are battling did not start with you. It started generations back in agreements made in ignorance, in curses spoken over bloodlines, in covenants entered by ancestors who did not understand the doors they were opening. Galatians 3:13 says, "Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us." I declare that every generational altar assigned to hinder marriage in your family dismantled. Every altar assigned to hinder finances in your family dismantled. Every altar assigned to hinder childbearing, hinder promotion, hinder peace, hinder long life dismantled in the name of Jesus. I speak to every satanic priest [music] and priestess ministering at an altar with your name written on it, your assignment has expired. The blood of Jesus cancels every legal ground you have exploited. I sense witchcraft activity around some of the assignments represented here, subtle, manipulative, working through people who smile at you in the daytime and plot against you in secret gatherings at night. Numbers 23:23 says, "Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel." I decree that every enchantment fashioned against you is being neutralized. Every divination spoken over your name in a coven, in a shrine, in a dream, in a whispered conversation, null and void. I command every satanic surveillance camera monitoring your progress to be shut down. I command every witchcraft padlock placed on your doors of opportunity to be broken. You will not be a permanent case study for demonic strategy. You are graduating from the file of the afflicted into the file of the favored. Let me leave the tone here because I don't want us to stay only in warfare. I want us to rise into worship because the presence of God is what actually shifts atmospheres, not merely our words about him. Take a moment and just lift your hands and thank him. Not for what he's about to do, for who he already is. Psalm 100:4 says, "Enter into his gates with thanksgiving and into his courts with praise. Be thankful unto him and bless his name." Something happens when thanksgiving precedes the miracle. It positions you as someone who trusts the character of God more than you trust the current circumstance. I feel a release of angelic assignment over this gathering right now. Hebrews 1:14 asks, "Are they not all ministering spirits sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?" I decree that angels are been dispatched tonight. Not vague poetic angels, but assigned specific purposeful messengers with instructions to move on your behalf. Some of you will notice it in strange favor this week. A stranger who helps you without being asked. A door that opens without the usual paperwork. A delay that suddenly clears without explanation. That's not luck. That's angelic activity responding to a decree released over your life in this hour. I speak now to the wasted years, the wasted energy, the wasted virtue poured into relationships and situations that drained you and gave nothing back. Joel's promise of restoration is not only for finances, it is for time itself. I decree that time is bending in your favor this week. What should have taken years is about to take days. What should have taken months is about to take hours. The compressed miracle is coming. The kind where people who knew your situation will ask, "How did this happen so fast?" And your only answer will be God did it. I want to prophesy over specific categories of people because the spirit is not generic. He is precise. To the business owner watching your capital shrink and wondering if you should close down, hold on. I decree a client is coming this week who will single-handedly change your cash flow. I decree a contract that has been stuck in negotiation is about to be signed. To the job seeker who have sent application after application into what feels like a void, I decree that one of those applications, maybe one you've almost forgotten about, is about to come back to life. Someone is reviewing your file right now and favor is resting on your name in that review. To the student anxious about results, about admission, about a future that feels uncertain, I decree clarity. I decree that the letter, the message, the notification you have been checking your phone for obsessively is about to arrive and it carries good news. To the person nursing a broken heart from betrayal by a friend, a partner, a business associate, I decree comfort is coming but more than comfort, I decree vindication. Psalm 23:5 says, "Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies." Somebody who watched you suffer, who perhaps even contributed to your suffering, is about to watch you rise and there will be nothing they can do about it but watch. To the person battling addiction, battling a private sin you haven't told anyone about, wrestling in shame, I decree freedom. Not condemnation freedom. John 8:36 says, "If the son therefore shall make you free, you shall be free indeed." I decree that this week the grip of that stronghold begins to loosen. Not through willpower alone, but through an encounter with grace that makes the old pattern lose its appeal. To the leader who feels alone at the top, carrying burdens no one around you understands, smiling in public while exhausted in private, I decree strength. I decree that God is sending you support, a person, a resource, a word that will remind you that you were never meant to carry this alone. I want to return to declarations now because I feel the fire rising again in this place. Say this after me out loud with conviction. I am not whom my current situation says I am. I am who God's word says I am. This week is not ordinary. This week carries my breakthrough. What the enemy delayed, God is about to release suddenly. My family is coming back together. My finances are being re-aligned with heaven's economy. My body is receiving strength I did not manufacture on my own. My marriage is being restored not by my effort alone but by divine intervention. Every altar assigned against me is dismantled by the blood of Jesus. I am surrounded by angels sent to work on my behalf. I will not miss my moment. >> [music] >> I will not sleep through my visitation. I receive it now. Let's press forward into prayer because declarations position you but prayer engages heaven directly. Father, we thank you for the reminder that you are not a God who forgets. Numbers 23:19 says God is not a man that he should lie neither the son of man that he should repent. Hath he said and shall he not do it or hath he spoken and shall he not make it good? You have spoken concerning us, Lord, and we hold you accountable to your own word not because we doubt you but because we trust your character enough to remind you of it in worship the way your own word instructs us to. Lord, for every person carrying a burden they haven't spoken aloud tonight, the fear that this is just another meeting, another word, another moment of temporary excitement that fades by Monday, Father, silence that fear now. Let this be the week testimonies are born from. Let this be the week the narrative changes. Let this be the week people stop saying I'm believing God for and start saying God did it. I decree over every prayer that has felt unanswered. It was heard the moment it was prayed. Revelation 8:4 says the smoke of the incense which came with the prayers of the saints ascended up before God. Your prayers did not evaporate. They ascended. They are recorded. And what is recorded in heaven eventually manifests on earth in God's timing. And I believe with everything in me that some of that timing converges on this very week. I speak to every closed womb represented here, physically or symbolically. Closed business, closed opportunity, closed relationship. Genesis 30:22 says, "And God remembered Rachel." And God hearkened to her and opened her womb. I decree that God remembers you. Not in the sense that he ever forgot, but in the sense that the appointed moment of remembrance of action has arrived. What has been dormant is about to conceive. What has been barren is about to bear fruit. I want to speak protection over this house before we close because breakthrough without preservation is incomplete. Psalm 91:10 says, "There shall no evil befall thee." Neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling. I decree divine preservation over every traveler in this gathering this week. Safety on every road, safety in every vehicle, safety in every flight. I decree preservation over your health. That no sudden ailment will interrupt the testimony that's coming. I decree preservation over your mind. That no attack of anxiety or depression will steal the joy of what God is about to do. I decree preservation over your relationships. That no misunderstanding will sabotage the restoration in motion. Whatever the enemy planned to use to distract you or destroy you this week, I cancel it in the name of Jesus. Let me speak now with tenderness because not everyone in this gathering needs fire right now. Some of you need comfort. Some of you are so tired that even hearing about breakthrough feels like pressure instead of hope. If that's you, I want you to hear this gently. God is not disappointed in your exhaustion. Matthew 11:28 says, "Come on to me, all ye that labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest." You don't have to hype yourself into faith tonight. You can simply rest in the fact that he already knows, he already sees, and he's already working, even in the moments you feel nothing. I sense someone here has been quietly asking God, "Do you still see me?" I want to answer that on his behalf tonight. Yes, he sees you. Genesis 16:13 records Hagar calling God, "Thou God seest me" after an encounter in the wilderness, a place of abandonment and fear. If God saw her in the wilderness, alone, forgotten by everyone else, he sees you in your version of the wilderness, too. And seeing in scripture is never passive. When God sees, he moves. I want to prophesy specifically now in short bursts. And I want you to receive whichever word lands on your spirit as yours. There is a call coming this week that will change the tone of your month. There is a document being signed somewhere on your behalf right now, without your knowledge. Someone is about to apologize to you, and it will bring closure you didn't know you needed. A financial obligation that has been pressuring you is about to be settled sooner than expected. Somebody's medical test is about to surprise the doctor. A relationship you have written off is about to be revived, but only if you remain teachable. Someone here is about to receive a message that begins with, "I've been thinking about you" from a person they thought had forgotten them. There is an opportunity forming right now that will not require you to compete for it. It is being handed to you. A pending visa, a pending approval, a pending confirmation is about to move from pending to processed. Somebody's long-standing prayer for a child is being answered in a manner that will leave no room for medical explanation alone. I feel the spirit shifting us into a final wave of intense intercession. So, let's go there together with everything we have left. Father, in the name of Jesus, we contend for this week. We do not release it back to the enemy's script. We do not accept a week that ends the same way it began for the people connected to this word. Let there be a divine interruption. Let something happen that no one in this gathering could have planned, orchestrated, or manufactured on their own. Something so clearly from you that testimonies will erupt from this room. I bind every spirit of delay in the name of Jesus. I bind every spirit of confusion assigned to scatter clear thinking at the exact moment decisions need to be made. I bind every spirit of fear that has been whispering it's not going to happen for you into the ears of the weary. I loose peace. I loose clarity. I loose courage. I loose supernatural boldness to walk through the doors that are about to open. I decree over the mothers interceding for wayward children. This week heaven answers you. I decree over the fathers carrying silent burdens for their households. This week heaven strengthens you. I decree over the widows and the overlooked and the forgotten. This week heaven remembers you specifically by name, not as a category, but as a person known intimately by the God who counts the hairs on your head. According to Matthew 10:30, I decree over every dream that was buried under years of disappointment, resurrection. Just as Lazarus heard his name called after 4 days in the grave in John 11:43, "Lazarus, come forth." I call your dream by name tonight. Whatever it is, the business idea, the ministry vision, the reconciliation you stopped believing for, the healing you stopped expecting, come forth. Before we move toward the close, I feel the spirit drawing my attention to a specific group in this gathering, those who have been serving faithfully behind the scenes, receiving little recognition, watching others celebrated while your own labor goes unnoticed. I speak to you directly. Colossians 3:4 23 says, "And whatsoever you do, do it heartily as to the Lord and not unto men." Heaven has been keeping account of every unseen sacrifice, every quiet act of obedience nobody applauded. I decree that this week recognition finds you, not because you sought it, but because God himself is bringing you into the light. What was done in secret is about to be rewarded openly according to Matthew 6:6. I also feel led to address the ones nursing quiet bitterness toward God, toward the church, toward people who wounded you in the house of faith itself. I understand that some of the deepest pain doesn't come from the world. It comes from those who should have protected you. But I want to minister to you gently. Unforgiveness, however justified it feels, becomes a locked door that even heaven's surprises struggle to pass through. Mark 11:25 instructs, "And when you stand praying, forgive if you have ought against any." I'm not asking you to pretend the wound didn't happen. I am asking you to release the debt so that your own breakthrough is not held hostage by someone else's offense. Let this week be the week you finally set that weight down, not for their sake, but for the sake of what God wants to do in you. Let me prophesy again because I sense the anointing intensifying rather than fading as we go deeper into this hour. There is a shift happening in the spirit realm right now over the affairs of everyone connected to this word. I see gates that have been rusted shut for years beginning to loosen on their hinges. I see rooms of decision makers, boards, panels, committees, immigration offices, medical review teams where your name is quietly rising to the top of stacks it had been buried under. I see conversations happening about you in your favor in rooms you are not even present in. Esther 6 tells the story of a king who could not sleep one night and in that sleeplessness he called for the chronicles to be read and Mordecai's forgotten act of loyalty was suddenly remembered and rewarded. I decree that somebody's sleepless night moment is being arranged for someone in authority over your situation right now. A moment where your name resurfaces at exactly the right time in exactly the right room. I want to pray now over the mental and emotional weight so many are carrying in silence. Some of you are functioning, showing up to work, smiling in family gatherings while quietly drowning underneath. 2 Corinthians 4:8 says, "We are troubled on every side yet not distressed. We are perplexed but not in despair." Father, we ask you to minister directly to the minds represented in this gathering. Where there is anxiety, exchange it for your peace which passes understanding according to Philippians 4:7. Where there is despair, let hope be reignited. Not shallow optimism but the kind of hope anchored in who you are. Let sleep return to those who have lost it to worry. Let clarity return to those whose thoughts have been clouded by grief or fear. We declare that no one connected to this word will be defined by their darkest week, but by the God who walks them through it and brings them out the other side. I sense there is someone here believing for reconciliation with a parent or a child after years of estrangement. The silence has stretched so long that speaking first feels impossible and pride or hurt has built a wall. Neither side knows how to climb down from. I decree that this week someone finds the courage to make the first move and I decree that the response on the other end will be softer than expected. Malachi 4:6 speaks of turning the hearts of the fathers to the children and the children to the fathers. That turning is not merely historical. It is available now in the households represented in this room. Let me also speak to those in transition, recently relocated, recently changed jobs, recently started a new season, and feeling disoriented, wondering if the decision was even right. I decree stability. I decree that the disorientation of a new season is temporary and that clarity about your assignment in this new place is coming swiftly. Isaiah 43:19 says, "Behold, I will do a new thing. Now it shall spring forth. Shall you not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness and rivers in the desert." What feels like wilderness right now is actually preparation ground for rivers you have not yet seen. Church, I want you to understand something about the nature of surprise. In scripture, it is almost always preceded by a season that looked like the opposite outcome was coming. The disciples on the road to Emmaus in Luke chapter 24 were walking away from Jerusalem in confusion and grief, convinced the story was over, when a stranger joined them on the road and their eyes were later open to recognize it was Jesus himself, they almost missed him because they were so consumed by disappointment. I want you tonight, do not let disappointment blind you to the very answer walking beside you this week. Stay alert, stay expectant. The breakthrough may not announce itself loudly. At first, it may look like a stranger on your road, an ordinary conversation, an unremarkable phone call before your eyes are open to what it actually was. I decree divine appointments over this week for everyone connected to this word. I decree that you will be in the right place at the right time, saying the right thing to the right person without even fully understanding the significance of it until later. I decree that missed opportunities from the past will not repeat themselves. That this time, you will recognize the moment and step into it. Father, we thank you in advance. We are not waiting until the surprise arrives to praise you. We are praising you now in faith. Believing that the report we will give by the end of this week will be different from the report we walked in with tonight. Let it be so, Lord. Let it be so. I want to close this ministration the way it began, with your voice, not mine, because the word only becomes yours when you speak it back to heaven. Say it with me and mean every syllable. I receive my surprise. I receive my breakthrough. I receive restoration in every area the enemy has attacked. I receive healing in my body. I receive peace in my home. I receive open doors in my finances. I receive divine connections assigned to my destiny. I receive angelic assistance working on my behalf right now. I will not talk myself out of this word out of fear of disappointment. I choose to believe that before this week ends, God will surprise me and I decree it is so in the mighty, matchless, all-sufficient name of Jesus Christ. Before you go, I want to leave one more instruction because a prophetic word without a corresponding action often fades by morning. Do not go home and simply file this away as a nice service. Find one specific situation, one, and pray over it deliberately every day this week out loud with expectation until the week ends. Watch it, track it, and when the surprise comes and it will come, do not keep it to yourself. Testify. Because your testimony will become someone else's turning point, the same way this word may be becoming yours right now. The Lord bless you and keep you. The Lord make his face shine upon you and be gracious unto you. The Lord lift up his countenance upon you and give you peace according to Numbers 6:24-26. Go from this place expecting, go from this place watching, go from this place ready because before this week ends, you will testify.
